title: nahrání hotové dávky, .don jako poslední
interface: final class Drupal\api_csobrec\Service\SftpUploader, no constructor arguments. upload(SftpSessionInterface $session, string $localDir, string $remoteDir): array — the session is already logged in; this service never opens a connection. It takes the plain files directly in $localDir: exactly one *.xml, exactly one *.don and at least one *.mp3; anything else in the directory (other extensions, subdirectories) is ignored. An incomplete set is \InvalidArgumentException whose message carries COUNTS, not file names — the names hold activity ids. A $localDir that is not a readable directory is \InvalidArgumentException too. Nothing is uploaded and the remote directory is not even listed when the set is incomplete. Then it lists $remoteDir once: a session error there becomes \RuntimeException naming that path, and nothing is uploaded — the module never creates the folder on their side, because a typo would ship the batch where nobody looks while the ledger claims ČSOB has it. Upload order: the mp3 files sorted by name, then the xml, and the .don LAST — it is ČSOB's marker that the batch is complete, so a failure part way through must leave no marker. Returns the remote paths in upload order, joined with a single '/' even when $remoteDir ends with one.
